verdict.rationale: turbopuffer is an HTTP API service, so offering a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows no such spec: every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404, and the docs never mention a spec download. The llms.txt file, markdown doc pages and multi-language SDKs are adjacent features, not a machine-readable API spec, so they earn no credit here.
